title: Analista de Requisitos/Negócios SR
description:
Papel estratégico na ponte entre negócio e tecnologia, responsável por construir a visão e o roadmap da solução, maximizar o valor entregue e garantir um backlog claro, priorizado e continuamente refinado em um contexto ágil.


Atividades principais:

  • Definir e comunicar a visão e o roadmap da solução, alinhando objetivos de negócio e métricas de sucesso.
  • Apoiar o time de negócios na priorização de entregas de maior valor, com base em dados e técnicas de priorização.
  • Manter o backlog claro, organizado e continuamente refinado (histórias, critérios de aceite, dependências).
  • Conduzir discovery e elicitação de requisitos com stakeholders, transformando necessidades em especificações acionáveis.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em Análise de Negócios/Requisitos em produtos e/ou soluções digitais, atuando de ponta a ponta.
  • Domínio de técnicas e notações: elicitação, BPMN, user stories/BDD, critérios de aceite e casos de uso.
  • Experiência com métodos ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), gestão de backlog e priorização, e ferramentas como Jira/Azure DevOps.
  • Excelente comunicação e gestão de stakeholders; orientação a valor e métricas (OKRs/KPIs).


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Engenheiro de Software (Java) (Exclusiva para Pessoa com Deficiência)
description:
Estamos contratando um(a) Software Engineer Mid Level para integrar o Billing Team no Brasil.


Este time é responsável por toda a plataforma que processa vendas, renovações de assinaturas e fluxos de receita, criando registros de recebíveis de clientes, além de gerenciar processos de cobrança (dunning).


As soluções desenvolvidas envolvem integrações globais com motores de cálculo de impostos, respeitando as complexidades de cada mercado, bem como a geração e envio de documentos fiscais às autoridades locais. O time também processa eventos de diversas fontes, transformando-os em lançamentos contábeis integrados ao ERP da empresa.


Seu impacto


Executar projetos estratégicos junto a um time de engenheiros(as) de software altamente qualificado;

Desenvolver soluções que suportam o processo de revenue recognition e contabilidade global da Wellhub;

Trabalhar em conjunto com um time de ~9 engenheiros(as) mid/sênior, implementando, testando e entregando soluções;

Atuar de forma hands-on, com foco em qualidade e escalabilidade;

Participar de melhorias em serviços existentes, como billing calculate e bill orchestrate, além de iniciativas voltadas para usuário e assinaturas



✅ Quem é você


Formação em Ciência da Computação ou experiência equivalente;

Experiência em engenharia de software, com histórico de entregas de qualidade;

Experiência em Java/Kotlin + Spring (RESTful APIs);

Conhecimentos em SQL (PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (DynamoDB);

Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e entendimento de escalabilidade;

Interesse em aprender mais sobre arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e Serverless;

Conhecimento em Cloud Computing (AWS) e Cloud Native (Kubernetes);

Inglês intermediário (essencial para documentação, comentários e comunicação interna), com abertura para evoluir

title: Junior Node Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

description:

  • Directly manage LX operational teams, starting with Customer Support, with Teaching to be added later
  • Design and implement efficient operational processes and structures to ensure stable performance in the region.

title: Engenheiros de IA
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Líder técnico de Java
description:
Líder Técnico Java - 13086


Contrato: CLT (alocado no cliente da UltraCon)

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto

Horário: Comercial

Idioma: Inglês Avançado

Remuneração: enviar pretensão salarial


Sobre a Vaga:

Buscamos um Líder Técnico Java experiente para orientar uma equipe de desenvolvedores no design, desenvolvimento e entrega de aplicações corporativas de alta performance, escaláveis e confiáveis.

O candidato ideal possui forte expertise técnica em Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Microservices e React, além de experiência comprovada em liderança dentro de ambientes Ágeis/Scrum.


Principais Responsabilidades:

• Liderar e mentorar uma equipe de 8–10 desenvolvedores, promovendo colaboração e excelência técnica.

• Conduzir iniciativas de desenvolvimento full stack usando Java 8/11, Spring Boot, Hibernate, React e arquitetura de microsserviços.

• Participar ativamente das cerimônias Ágeis/Scrum, apoiando o Scrum Master e garantindo o cumprimento das metas do sprint.

• Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para definir, projetar e entregar soluções de software de alta qualidade.

• Gerenciar comunicação e alinhamento com o cliente, garantindo aderência técnica e entregas dentro do prazo.

• Aplicar raciocínio analítico e algoritmos para resolver problemas complexos e projetar arquiteturas escaláveis.

• Garantir conformidade com pipelines de CI/CD, padrões de qualidade de código e melhores práticas de DevOps.

• Manter-se atualizado sobre novas tecnologias e recomendar melhorias de arquitetura e processos.


Habilidades e Experiência Necessárias:

• Sólida experiência prática em desenvolvimento Java/J2EE e frameworks relacionados.

• Pelo menos 1 ano de experiência recente como Líder Técnico em projetos Ágeis/Scrum.

• Forte proficiência em:

o Core Java (JDK 1.8 / Java 8–11)

o Spring Boot e Spring Framework (últimas versões)

o Hibernate / Spring Data

o Microsserviços (REST APIs)

o React, HTML, CSS e JavaScript (Full Stack)

• Sólidos conhecimentos em bancos de dados: Oracle, MySQL, DB2, MongoDB.

• Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento e CI/CD: Git, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Chef.

• Experiência prática com plataformas de nuvem: PCF, Azure ou AWS.

• Entendimento do framework SAFe 4 e princípios Ágeis.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders.


Mais informações serão fornecidas durante a entrevista técnica.

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

  • Identificação e resolução de gargalos de performance em aplicações e banco de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.
  • Experiência em logs estruturados e telemetria  (Application Insights, Serilog, Sentry, etc.).


Vivência em times ágeis

  • Experiência trabalhando em squads com Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Participação em cerimônias (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva).
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa em ambientes distribuídos/remotos.


    • Experiências Desejáveis (não obrigatórias, mas valorizadas)
    • Projetos com DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , eventos de domínio e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus).
    • Experiência implementando estratégias de resiliência  (retry, fallback, circuit breaker).
    • Projetos de monitoramento avançado com telemetria e métricas de performance.
    • Participação em arquiteturas escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade.



    Diferenciais
    • Ter trabalhado com Ext.js  em sistemas legados.
    • Experiência em Blazor  (Server ou WebAssembly).
    • Portfólio com projetos relevantes em produção.

title: BD(Recruited Agencies)
description:
Corporate Information

TRANSSNET Group is a joint venture company established by China's leading Internet company NetEase Group (NASDAQ: NTES) and TRANSSION Holdings Group, a global provider of smart terminal products and mobile value-added services. TRANSSNET combines NetEase’s strong technical strength and advanced Internet product operation concepts with TRANSSION’s mature channel resources and solid market foundation in Africa, becoming one of the leading Internet companies serving the most users in Africa with excellent online applications from Boomplay, the largest online music platform in Africa, to TalkTalk and SOYO, both extraordinary social apps, to mobile games.


This position will serve the social app(SOYO) business unit.


Job Requirements:

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • At least one year of experience in agency recruitment or management.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to make friends with users.
  • Sales-oriented mindset with patience.
  • Enjoy using voice social apps, familiar with various features and gameplay.
  • Reliable and loyal, with integrity and a goal-oriented approach.


Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for recruiting agencies and hosts (at least 200-300 hosts per month)
  • Assist in the translation of events and product features (English to Portuguese)

title: US Tax & Accounting Specialist – Foreign-Owned & Domestic Entities (100% Remote)
description:
About Us

At Space Financial Group, we help entrepreneurs from the US, Latin America, Brazil, and worldwide set up and run U.S. companies the right way. We specialize in LLCs, S-Corps, tax compliance, bookkeeping, and Virtual CFO services for both foreign-owned U.S. entities and traditional American clients.

We’re growing fast and need an experienced, detail-oriented accounting and tax professional who loves solving complex cross-border puzzles and delivering peace of mind to clients.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare and file U.S. federal (and some state) tax returns for:

- Single-member & multi-member LLCs (Form 1065, Schedule K-1)

- S-Corporations (Form 1120-S, K-1s)

- Foreign-owned U.S. disregarded entities and corporations (Form 5472, 1120)

- U.S. individual tax returns (Form 1040, 1040-NR for non-residents)

  • Manage monthly/quarterly bookkeeping and financial statement preparation using QuickBooks Online
  • Oversee payroll compliance when applicable
  • Advise clients (in Spanish, Portuguese, or English) on tax-saving strategies, entity structuring, BOI reporting (FinCEN), and compliance timelines
  • Review and correct client-provided records, flag red flags, and ensure data accuracy
  • Collaborate with U.S.-based CPAs/Enrolled Agents on complex cases while owning day-to-day execution


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of recent U.S. tax preparation experience with partnerships, S-Corps, and individuals
  • Practical experience with foreign-owned U.S. entities (Form 5472, 1120) is a strong plus
  • Solid background preparing Form 1040 for U.S. citizens/residents
  • Mastery of QuickBooks Online (QBO)
  • Advanced Excel skills and ability to build models or schedules
  • Fluency in Spanish , English , and Portuguese


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are…

  • Extremely organized and deadline-driven
  • Great at simplifying complex tax concepts across different languages
  • Curious about cross-border legal and tax structures
  • Comfortable working remotely and independently
  • Proactive – you spot problems before the IRS does


Compensation & Benefits

  • R$6,000 – R$9,000 BRL/month (depending on experience & certifications)
  • 100% remote – work from anywhere
  • Paid time off
  • Annual training/conference budget

title: US Tax & Accounting Specialist – Foreign-Owned & Domestic Entities (100% Remote)
description:
About Us

At Space Financial Group, we help entrepreneurs from the US, Latin America, Brazil, and worldwide set up and run U.S. companies the right way. We specialize in LLCs, S-Corps, tax compliance, bookkeeping, and Virtual CFO services for both foreign-owned U.S. entities and traditional American clients.

We’re growing fast and need an experienced, detail-oriented accounting and tax professional who loves solving complex cross-border puzzles and delivering peace of mind to clients.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare and file U.S. federal (and some state) tax returns for:

- Single-member & multi-member LLCs (Form 1065, Schedule K-1)

- S-Corporations (Form 1120-S, K-1s)

- Foreign-owned U.S. disregarded entities and corporations (Form 5472, 1120)

- U.S. individual tax returns (Form 1040, 1040-NR for non-residents)

  • Manage monthly/quarterly bookkeeping and financial statement preparation using QuickBooks Online
  • Oversee payroll compliance when applicable
  • Advise clients (in Spanish, Portuguese, or English) on tax-saving strategies, entity structuring, BOI reporting (FinCEN), and compliance timelines
  • Review and correct client-provided records, flag red flags, and ensure data accuracy
  • Collaborate with U.S.-based CPAs/Enrolled Agents on complex cases while owning day-to-day execution


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of recent U.S. tax preparation experience with partnerships, S-Corps, and individuals
  • Practical experience with foreign-owned U.S. entities (Form 5472, 1120) is a strong plus
  • Solid background preparing Form 1040 for U.S. citizens/residents
  • Mastery of QuickBooks Online (QBO)
  • Advanced Excel skills and ability to build models or schedules
  • Fluency in Spanish , English , and Portuguese


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are…

  • Extremely organized and deadline-driven
  • Great at simplifying complex tax concepts across different languages
  • Curious about cross-border legal and tax structures
  • Comfortable working remotely and independently
  • Proactive – you spot problems before the IRS does


Compensation & Benefits

  • R$6,000 – R$9,000 BRL/month (depending on experience & certifications)
  • 100% remote – work from anywhere
  • Paid time off
  • Annual training/conference budget

title: Quality Control Lead
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a structured, strict, and technically-minded Head of Quality Assurance who will build and lead one of the most critical operational units in the company.

Scope of responsibility:

  • Management of a team of 30+ remote assistants
  • Quality control of 5,000+ job applications/month (scaling to 10,000+)
  • Direct reporting to the CEO


Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • 30 assistants submit job applications on behalf of clients
  • Quality is inconsistent—there is no systematic control
  • Many manual review processes → we need automation
  • No structured onboarding for new assistants
  • No clear KPIs or performance-based motivation


What must be built:

Audit the current team

Hire additional assistants

Build a full Quality Assurance system from scratch

Automate quality checks in collaboration with engineering

Implement onboarding, training, and control processes


Key Responsibilities

Build a Quality Assurance system (30%)

First 2 weeks:

  • Audit current assistants
  • Evaluate work quality (accuracy, speed, compliance)
  • Decide who stays, who leaves
  • Create quality criteria and checklists

Ongoing:

  • Implement regular quality audits and spot-checks
  • Establish KPIs (quality, speed, customer satisfaction)
  • Track quality metrics per assistant
  • Identify repeating errors and remove root causes
  • Review difficult cases with the team

Hiring & Onboarding (25%)

Hiring:

  • Design the hiring funnel (screening → test task → interview)
  • Hire new assistants within first 1–2 months
  • Maintain a candidate pipeline (no current churn, but may appear)

Onboarding & training:

  • Build a structured onboarding program (1–2 weeks)
  • Teach systems, standards, and workflows
  • Certify assistants before they start working with clients
  • Create training materials, videos, guides

Automation & Technology (20%)

Work with engineering team:

  • Identify which checks can be automated
  • Create clear requirements and tasks for developers
  • Test and launch automation tools
  • Utilize AI and scripts for monitoring

Automation examples:

  • Automatic validation of application fields
  • Duplicate application detection
  • Performance dashboards and speed tracking
  • Quality alert system
  • Real-time monitoring tools

Team Management (15%)

  • Workload distribution among assistants
  • KPI tracking and performance reviews
  • Escalation handling and issue resolution
  • Motivation and team culture development

People development:

  • Selective 1:1s
  • Coaching low performers
  • Promote top performers into team leads
  • Create internal career paths

Continuous improvement (10%)

  • Identify bottlenecks and improve processes
  • Implement best practices and standardization
  • Maintain operations documentation
  • Work with client complaints, root cause elimination

Requirements

Must-Have:

2+ years managing operational teams

  • Experience managing 20+ employees
  • Built processes from scratch
  • Preferably BPO/outsourcing/call center/EdTech

Strong systems thinking and discipline

  • SOPs, checklists, regulations, compliance
  • Precision and attention to detail
  • Ability to make difficult decisions (terminations, corrective action)

Technical competency

  • Understanding of automation & quality monitoring
  • Ability to write clear requirements for developers
  • Experience with CRM, monitoring dashboards, etc.
  • Nice-to-have: SQL basics, API logic, scripting

Analytical approach

  • Metrics: quality %, speed, productivity, error rate
  • KPI systems and reporting
  • Data-driven decision-making

Experience in hiring & onboarding


Strong Plus:

BPO/outsourcing experience (data entry, support, back office)

Quality automation experience

Technical degree (engineering / CS / math)

Six Sigma/Lean/Kaizen knowledge

Experience scaling teams from 10 → 50+

QA/Quality Management certifications

Experience with distributed remote teams

title: Consultor SAP MM/WM (AMS)
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidade:

  • Consultor(a) para compor o time de AMS da NTT DATA realizando atendimento de chamados de sustentação e melhorias nos módulos MM/WM.


Requisitos:

  • Formação Superior Completo
  • Experiência como Consultor Pleno MM e WM.
  • Desejável conhecimento do EWM.
  • Experiência com implementação e/ou suporte AMS.
  • Inglês Avançado - Desejável


Formato de Trabalho: Remoto

Tipo de contrato: CLT


Garantimos que nossos funcionários sejam bem tratados, oferecendo pacotes de remuneração específicos para cada país, programas de reconhecimento e benefícios de prevenção. Dessa forma, incentivamos nossos colaboradores a terem o melhor desempenho e a comemorarem suas conquistas.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Tools Automation Lead
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás , com operações globais e foco em dados, automação de processos corporativos e integração entre plataformas. A área está em expansão e busca elevar padrões de governança, automação e eficiência através de tecnologias Azure, Power Platform e Azure DevOps.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e otimizar processos de ingestão e transformação de dados utilizando ADF e DBT.
  • Modelar dados complexos, aplicando normalização, desnormalização e arquitetura em star schema.
  • Administrar ambientes Azure DevOps, incluindo permissões, projetos, repositórios e integrações.
  • Propor e implementar automações e workflows utilizando Power Platform e Azure DevOps.
  • Colaborar com times internos e externos avaliando viabilidade técnica de integrações e automações.
  • Suportar novos casos de uso dentro de Azure DevOps, considerando escalabilidade e integração com sistemas corporativos (GitHub, ServiceNow, Azure).

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em administração de Azure DevOps e automações com Power Platform
  • Experiência com SQL, DAX, ADF e DBT.
  • Experiência prática em modelagem de dados e processos EL/ETL.
  • Vivência com Azure para armazenamento, processamento e integração.
  • Comunicação clara com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos em inglês.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico, lidando com múltiplas demandas.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

Experiência em Python e PowerQuery / Power BI.

Certificações relevantes, como:

  • DP-203: Azure Data Engineer Associate
  • PL-500: Power Platform Developer Associate


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Analista QA - Remoto (Inglês Fluente)
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 17 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Analista QA - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas; - Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

  • Atuação em uma empresa global da área da saúde.
  • Atuação 100% home office, em horário comercial.
  • Contratação CLT.



O que esperamos de você:

• Experiência em testes de automação (frontend UI and API automation)

• Excelentes habilidades na escrita de consultas SQL e bons conhecimentos em bancos de dados Oracle/SQL

• Compreensão de qualquer linguagem: Java/Python (preferencia pra Python).

• Experiência em desenvolvimento ágil, conhecimento no uso do GIT, PyCharm, Jenkins, Jira, Confluence.

• Experiência prática em ferramentas de automação como Selenium/UFT.

• Conhecimento em Testes de Segurança.

description:

- Participate in Agile development and CI/CD processes.

- Support operational tasks and troubleshoot issues.

- Experience in Java and Golang development.

- Knowledge of microservices architecture and API design.

- Familiarity with AWS services (Lambda, S3).

- Basic understanding of Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Junior Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Java Developer to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics, and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure the code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Automation Anywhere Senior RPA Developer
description:
Practia is present in 7 countries, leading automation and digital transformation projects for major clients. We are one of the most prestigious business and technology companies in Latin America, with a specialized methodology and technical team in automation and Hyperautomation.


We have partnerships and certifications with leading market platforms, acting as a Diamond Partner with UiPath, Platinum Partner with Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner with Microsoft, and Silver Partner with IBM. Our experience and expertise in automation services have earned us, among various awards, the USN (UiPath Service Network) badge and UiPath's LATAM Partner of the Year award.

We are looking for a Senior RPA Developer with expertise in the Automation Anywhere 360 platform to support us in a strategic project alongside a team of analysts and developers.

This person will be involved in the entire RPA development cycle, starting from reviewing the functional documentation, defining development complexity, providing support for solution design and architecture, developing the automation, and supporting testing phases, automation deploy in production and hypercare.

They will be trained in our exclusive development framework and Hyperautomation methodology, SmartBPA®, which spans from Discovery to COE implementation.

As a key contributor to the Intelligent Automation Program , you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, solution architects, and IT professionals, to automate complex business processes while ensuring high-quality, maintainable, and secure automation solutions.


What are we looking for?

  • A person with seniority, experience and expertise in automation development.
  • A person with a consultative and collaborative approach.
  • A person who enjoys working in an environment that fosters competence, transparency, and trust.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or Administration.
  • Experience in automation development with Automation Anywhere platform (Minimum of 5 years).
  • Automation Anywhere 360 Advanced and Master certifications.
  • Design, develop, deploy and sustain end-to-end automation solutions using Automation Anywhere A360.
  • Build and maintain reusable bot components
  • Integrate GenAI/ML, IDP, and APIs into automation workflows for enhanced functionality.
  • Work closely with the Solution Architect to ensure best practices, security, and compliance in automation solutions.


Job Requirements

  • Hands-on experience integrating RPA solutions with APIs, databases, and enterprise applications.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, VBScript or JavaScript.
  • Experience in design, develop and debug complex automation workflows and implement robust error-handling mechanisms.
  • Experience in integrating GenAI, ML and IDP into intelligent automation solutions
  • Queue management.
  • Development of standardized documentation (PDD and SDD).
  • Use of frameworks.
  • Experience with Agile methodology, mainly using Scrum and Kanban.
  • Fluent in English.


Knowledge that may be a differential for the position:

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms services like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Knowledge of Automation Anywhere IA Agents, IA Studio, Enterprise Knowledge and Document Automation products.
  • Other certifications and trainings in the intelligent automation field.

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Data Engineer AWS Expert who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Proven experience with AWS (API Gateway, Lambda/Fargate, S3, Glue, CloudWatch). Strong knowledge of PySpark (partitioning, joins, optimization). Experience with Glue Data Catalog and querying via Athena. Experience with integration and manipulation of data in REST APIs. Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation). Good practices in version control (Git) and CI/CD.


Experience with columnar and table formats (Parquet, Delta, Hudi, Iceberg).

Use of Data Quality tools (Great Expectations, Soda).

Knowledge of Step Functions, EventBridge, or Kinesis.

Best practices for API security (Cognito, WAF, IAM Policies).

Soft Skills:

Good communication and teamwork.

Proactivity in problem-solving.

Ability to handle agile environments and rapid changes.


Design, develop, and maintain APIs using AWS API Gateway.

Implement integrations with Lambda or Fargate for data ingestion.

Develop processing pipelines in PySpark (AWS Glue or EMR).

Manage data in S3 and Glue Data Catalog.

Ensure data quality and integrity (data quality checks).

Optimize pipeline costs and performance.

Create and maintain technical documentation and development standards.

description:
Sobre a empresa

Somos a SEIDOR, multinacional de tecnologia e inovação, que oferece um portfólio completo de soluções e serviços para promover a competitividade e a transformação das organizações. São mais de 40 anos acreditando na tecnologia , com 85 escritórios e uma equipe de mais de 7.500 profissionais na Europa, América Latina, Estados Unidos, África, Oriente Médio e Ásia.


Somos parceiros platinum da SAP e temos mais de 8.500 clientes . Nosso portfólio completo é voltado para empresas grandes, médias e em crescimento. Na SEIDOR acreditamos que, para enfrentar os novos desafios do mundo digital, devemos ter os melhores aliados, as tecnologias líderes de mercado e, acima de tudo, as melhores pessoas.


Nós acreditamos no valor das pessoas . Buscamos constantemente atrair e reter talentos, investindo no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e oferecendo oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Nosso time é composto por profissionais colaborativos, autônomos e ágeis que juntos formam um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, dinâmico e sem discriminação, respeitando as diferenças que nos tornam mais humanos.


✨ Venha fazer parte desse novo projeto! ✨

Tem os requisitos abaixo? Então essa vaga é para você ! ✨

  • Gerente de Projetos S/4Hana Sênior


Sobre a oportunidade:

  • Início: Assim que aprovado
  • Prazo: Indeterminado, fazer parte do time da consultoria
  • Atividades: Liderar e gerenciar projetos de implementação e migração do SAP S/4Hana
  • Aplicar a metodologia SAP Activate para garantir a execução eficiente dos projetos dentro do prazo e orçamento
  • Definir cronogramas, metas, recursos e orçamento do projeto
  • Garantir que todos os requisitos de negócios sejam mapeados e atendidos na solução SAP S/4Hana
  • Coordenar e liderar equipes multifuncionais (consultores, analistas de TI, desenvolvedores e áreas de negócios)
  • Gerenciar a integração do SAP S/4Hana com outros sistemas e plataformas já existentes na empresa
  • Acompanhar o progresso do projeto e comunicar-se regularmente com as partes interessadas para garantir alinhamento contínuo
  • Garantir a entrega de treinamento para os usuários finais e suporte pós-implementação
  • Identificar e gerenciar riscos durante o ciclo de vida do projeto, propondo soluções adequadas


Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento avançado da metodologia SAP Activate e experiência na aplicação dessa metodologia em projetos de grande porte
  • Habilidade para gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e cumprir prazos rigorosos


Diferenciais:

  • Certificação SAP Activate, PMP ou equivalente

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
Project description

Building a risk applications and tools for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising the systems for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe), etc


Responsibilities

The Team is focused on the development and maintenance of various applications. The successful candidate will have considerable and proven experience in Python, a good working knowledge of end-user and server-side data processing techniques, a good understanding of SDLC and agile development methodologies.


Skills

Must have

Strong understanding of data quality principles

Hands-on exp with Python

at least 1 year of experience in trading domain/capital markets

Proven experience in designing and developing data models using industry best practices

Experience in using code management and CI/CD tools such as Github, Azure Devops, Jenkins, Bamboo etc.

5+ years of experience working with Python

Good understanding and demonstrated experience working with SQL (MySQL).

Extensive experience designing and developing reports and performance metrics from complex and disparate platforms

Experience in using code management and CI/CD tools such as Github, Azure Devops, Jenkins, Bamboo etc.

5+ years of experience working with Python

Good understanding and demonstrated experience working with Power Query (M query language) and DAX.

Extensive experience designing and developing reports and performance metrics from complex and disparate platforms


Languages

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

ID:

title: Microsoft Power Platform Developer
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Atribuições:

- Desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando plataformas Low Code;

- Documentar especificações técnicas e funcionais das aplicações/portais desenvolvidas;

- Colaborar com diferentes áreas de negócio para levantamento de requisitos e tradução dos mesmos para tecnologia;

- Monitorizar e suportar as aplicações desenvolvidas, garantindo a evolução continua das mesmas e suporte aos utilizadores finais.


Habilidades técnicas:

- Experiência com a Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps e Power Automate);

- Power BI;

- Dataverse;

- Power Pages;

- Copilot Studio;

- Experiência em projetos de governança Power Platform;

- Noções de gestão de projetos.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.


We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team
  • Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Senior Full-stack (Python)
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Full-stack Python Engineer to join our team and contribute to building scalable, high-performance applications. The ideal candidate is passionate about clean code, system design, and continuous learning, while also mentoring others and collaborating across teams.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, and maintain scalable Python applications .
  • Write clean, efficient, and reusable code following best practices and coding standards.
  • Participate in code reviews , ensuring code quality, maintainability, and team knowledge sharing.
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues effectively and in a timely manner.
  • Contribute to the architecture and design of new features and systems.
  • Take full ownership and pride in your work and the overall codebase.
  • Mentor and support other developers, promoting learning and professional growth.
  • Demonstrate a strong track record of mentorship and collaboration across varying experience levels.
  • Maintain awareness of application security, performance, and scalability best practices.
  • Show a strong desire to continuously learn and evolve technical skills.
  • Approach problem-solving with a pragmatic and results-oriented mindset .


Required Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Python , with experience using frameworks such as Flask .
  • Cloud experience , particularly with AWS (Amazon Web Services) .
  • Proven experience integrating frontend applications with RESTful APIs and backend services.
  • Solid experience with relational and non-relational databases (SQL Server, Snowflake, MongoDB).
  • Strong skills in debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting .
  • Advanced English (mandatory) – strong written and verbal communication skills required for daily collaboration in an international environment.

title: Recruiting Operations Manager
description:
Company Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a US national healthcare recruiting firm that focuses on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.


We are hiring a Recruiting Operations Manager to work directly with the CEO. This person will take ideas, conversations, and action items and turn them into completed projects. The right candidate will be the operational backbone of the recruiting process, ensuring accuracy, follow-through, and consistent momentum.


If you are organized, resourceful, and skilled at turning plans into results, this role is for you.


About the CEO and the Role

Max McNamara is the CEO of Full Spectrum Search Group. With over 13 years of search experience and a degree in Technological Entrepreneurship and Management, Max combines hands-on recruiting expertise with a strong focus on systems, process, and performance. He has also served as a coach and workflow automation consultant for one of the largest recruiting firm networks in the world, helping build smarter infrastructure and scalable operations across multiple search organizations.


Max is a visionary who thrives on ideas, relationships, and growth. He’s looking for an Integrator who can bring structure, accountability, and follow-through. This role is both strategic and tactical. You’ll be a true operational partner and someone who keeps the recruiting engine running smoothly, ensures every opportunity moves from conversation to completion, and turns ideas into measurable results.


Recruiting Operations and Workflow Management

  • Attend client, candidate, and internal meetings and own the post-meeting follow-through by ensuring every conversation leads to completed next steps
  • Manage all recruiting activity in Crelate (CRM) including job orders, candidate pipelines, and client updates.
  • Keep data clean, organized, syndicated, and current across LinkedIn RPS, Crelate, and lead spreadsheets.
  • Ensure all searches are actively moving forward and nothing sits idle.
  • Create weekly progress summaries and present during weekly team meetings


Process Improvement & Automation

  • Strong emphasis on workflow automation and continually looking for relevant and savvy ways to make things more efficient, eliminate bottle necks, etc.
  • Proactively look for areas to improve process and workflows and suggest edits
  • Become the subject matter on industry tools and technologies that can lead to better results over time.


Team Coordination and Communication

  • Collaborate with internal team members to keep projects on track and deadlines met.
  • Draft clear, professional recap messages after client and candidate calls.
  • Coordinate and manage the CEO’s calendar for efficiency and balance.
  • Follow up with recruiters and support staff to make sure deliverables are completed and priorities stay aligned.


Research, Marketing, and Deliverables

  • Research operators, facilities, and leadership teams using internal templates and data sources.
  • Maintain and update tracking lists for sourcing, outreach, and facility-level research.
  • Format and proofread MPC write-ups, job descriptions, and client submissions using company templates and tone.
  • Support marketing activities including LinkedIn posts and client-facing materials to ensure brand consistency.


What You’ll Bring

  • Excellent written and spoken English suitable for professional U.S. business communication.
  • Understanding of American business culture and communication style.
  • Experience working with US-based companies in operations and/or

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant


Remote – Brazil


*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.


Company Overview


Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.


Position Overview


As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  • Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  • Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  • Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  • Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  • Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  • Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  • Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  • Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  • Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  • Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  • Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  • Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  • Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  • Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  • Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  • Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  • Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  • Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  • Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  • Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  • Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  • Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Líder Técnico III (Angular/.Net)
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar na liderança técnica de projetos de software, no ICC PDI SW.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Liderar tecnicamente times e projetos de desenvolvimento de software, propondo soluções que atendam ao negócio e sejam performáticas e flexíveis, considerando requisitos de escalabilidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções integradas;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica do projeto, operacionais e de apoio à gerência;
  • Definir e documentar arquitetura lógica e executável de sistemas, assim como realizar a especificação funcional de projetos;
  • Prover solução e suporte para o desenvolvimento de funcionalidades de soluções web;
  • Desenvolver aplicações de alto nível;
  • Prover suporte ao time de QA;
  • Revisar código desenvolvido conforme boas práticas da tecnologia;
  • Projetar software para integração e entrega contínua;
  • Prover capacitação, orientação e suporte técnico aos desenvolvedores;
  • Realizar o planejamento e o monitoramento das atividades técnicas dos projetos.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo em cursos da área de tecnologia como Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Experiência em:

  • Desenvolvimento de soluções com C#, .Net Core e Angular,
  • Cultura DevOps,
  • Metodologias de desenvolvimento ágeis;


Domínio em:

  • Desenvolvimento e design de arquitetura de soluções web,
  • Banco de dados não relacional/relacional,
  • Webservices, APIs, Design patterns,
  • Modelagem de projetos,
  • Containerização de aplicação (Docker/Kubernetes),
  • Ferramentas de análise de código e de controle de versionamento de código;


Conhecimentos em:

  • Integração com SAP,
  • Pipeline CI/CD para desenvolvimento, integração e deploy de aplicações web,
  • Testes automatizados e unitários,
  • Ferramentas de design UX/UI.


Seria interessante se você tivesse:

  • Inglês intermediário.


Informações adicionais

Horário de trabalho: Segunda a sexta, das 8h as 12h e das 13h30 as 17h30.


Local de trabalho : As atividades poderão ser realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho "Home Office".

title: Supervisor de Lazer
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Supervisionar, treinar e motivar os agentes de viagens;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho individual e coletivo da equipe;
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e orientado para resultados.
  • Garantir um atendimento de excelência aos clientes, presencialmente, por telefone ou online;
  • Resolver conflitos, reclamações e situações complexas de atendimento;
  • Manter um padrão de qualidade nos serviços prestados pela equipe.
  • Supervisionar a montagem de pacotes turísticos, nacionais e internacionais;
  • Apoiar na negociação com fornecedores (companhias aéreas, hotéis, operadoras, etc.);
  • Garantir que as ofertas estejam atualizadas, competitivas e dentro das políticas da empresa.
  • Acompanhar reservas, emissões, alterações e cancelamentos de serviços;
  • Monitorar prazos, documentos e pagamentos junto aos fornecedores;
  • Garantir que todos os processos estejam em conformidade com as normas legais e políticas internas.
  • Colaborar com o setor comercial para alcançar metas de vendas;
  • Sugerir campanhas, promoções e ações para captação e fidelização de clientes;
  • Analisar relatórios de desempenho e propor melhorias.
  • Monitorar metas, produtividade e qualidade do atendimento;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentar resultados à direção.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre destinos, tendências do mercado e novidades do setor;
  • Incentivar a equipe a participar de treinamentos, workshops e famtours.

title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


This is a large impact role that demands someone who can excel in a fast paced and ever changing environment.


Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

  • Mentorar desenvolvedores plenos e juniores por meio de code reviews, pair programming e feedbacks construtivos;
  • Contribuir para a definição e evolução de padrões de desenvolvimento, testes e deploy;
  • Atuar na integração de APIs complexas e no processamento de fluxos de dados em grande escala;
  • Colaborar com Arquitetos, Tech Leads e Product Owners para criar soluções escaláveis e robustas;
  • Garantir a implementação de testes abrangentes e a automação de pipelines de CI/CD no frontend;
  • Otimizar performance e solucionar problemas complexos nos sistemas;
  • Assegurar alta cobertura de testes automatizados e fomentar uma cultura contínua de qualidade;
  • Desenvolver componentes complexos e reutilizáveis utilizando React, TypeScript e Material UI;
  • Arquitetar e otimizar o gerenciamento de estado com Redux/Redux Toolkit, incluindo criação de middlewares customizados;

  • Conhecimento em automação de testes end-to-end;
  • Experiência em times ágeis e ambientes de alta complexidade;
  • Vivência com integração de sistemas, automação e CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em acessibilidade, performance e seguranç;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Realizar o desenvolvimento técnico de novas funcionalidades e arquiteturas de frontend com React;
  • Definir e disseminar boas práticas de desenvolvimento, qualidade de código, performance e componentização;
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores plenos e juniores por meio de code reviews, pair programming e feedbacks construtivos;
  • Contribuir para a definição e evolução de padrões de desenvolvimento, testes e deploy;
  • Atuar na integração de APIs complexas e no processamento de fluxos de dados em grande escala;
  • Colaborar com Arquitetos, Tech Leads e Product Owners para criar soluções escaláveis e robustas;
  • Garantir a implementação de testes abrangentes e a automação de pipelines de CI/CD no frontend;
  • Otimizar performance e solucionar problemas complexos nos sistemas;
  • Assegurar alta cobertura de testes automatizados e fomentar uma cultura contínua de qualidade;
  • Desenvolver componentes complexos e reutilizáveis utilizando React, TypeScript e Material UI;
  • Arquitetar e otimizar o gerenciamento de estado com Redux/Redux Toolkit, incluindo criação de middlewares customizados;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código com ESLint, Prettier e TypeScript;
  • Implementar e otimizar comunicação em tempo real com WebSockets;
  • Containerizar aplicações com Docker para ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção.

title: Graphic Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


What we're looking for


We’re looking for a Graphic Designer who’s skilled in UX/UI design, with a sharp eye for layout, consistency, and visual storytelling. If you're someone who can take a creative brief and turn it into sleek, conversion-friendly assets that speak to a SaaS audience — we want to hear from you.

You’ll collaborate with our design and content teams to create assets that live across websites, social, decks, and beyond.


What you'll do


  • Design branded visuals for SaaS startups (one-pagers, pitch decks, social ads, case studies, etc.)
  • Work on presentation design, marketing collateral, and internal brand materials
  • Apply consistent visual systems across different formats and platforms
  • Collaborate with Product Designers, Copywriters, and Founders to translate ideas into clean, strategic visuals
  • Create and refine brand identities when needed (logo, color, typography, etc.)
  • Support UI/Web design tasks with visual assets (icons, illustrations, mockups)
  • Deliver assets quickly, adapt based on feedback, and iterate fast
  • Requirements:Strong portfolio with examples of branding, marketing, and presentation work
  • Proficiency in Canva, Figma, Illustrator, or Photoshop
  • Experience designing for SaaS or B2B audiences
  • Understanding of modern design trends, visual hierarchy, and conversion principles
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines
  • Comfort in fast-paced environments with direct feedback loops
  • Excellent written and spoken English


Nice to have


  • Experience designing websites in Webflow or Framer
  • 5+ years as a graphic designer
  • Animation skills (e.g., Lottie, After Effects)
  • Knowledge of performance design (A/B testing, CRO, etc.)
  • Familiarity with social media platforms and ad formats



Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a Graphic Designer with a passion for creating clean and functional designs, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and
